title: Object data (map/war3map.w3u.json, .w3t, .w3b, .w3d, .w3a, .w3h, .w3q)
description: The project form of the object data files (units, items, destructables, doodads, abilities, buffs, upgrades; also war3mapSkin.* and war3campaign.*), written by crates/w3proj/src/objdata.rs. Keys the codec doesn't know are allowed: it ignores them (they don't reach the packed map).

original.description: changes to the game's own objects

id.description: four bytes: four printable ASCII characters ("hfoo"), or "0x" and 8 hex digits

base.description: the object it is made from (custom) or changes (original)

id.description: a custom object's own id; missing means four zero bytes (an original object)

end.description: the token after each change, where a change has no `end` of its own; missing means four zero bytes

sets.description: version 3, when the object has anything but one set with flag 0: its changes per set

mods.description: the changes (of the one set with flag 0 in version 3); missing means none

level.description: .w3d, .w3a, .w3q: the level (or variation); 0 when missing, not stored in the other files

data.description: .w3d, .w3a, .w3q: the data column (A to F as 1 to 6); 0 when missing, not stored in the other files

value.description: an int, a real or unreal (stored as a 32-bit float) or a string, by `type`

end.description: only where it differs from the object's `end`
